products.product_description: An Pan bun is a sweet roll filled with sweet red bean paste, stamped with black sesame seeds on top. Product is packaged in clear polypropylene bag, heat sealed with white labels on front and back. Net wt. 2.9pz. UPC 854077007055. The affected label states "**INGREDIENTS: Azuki Filling (Sugar, water, red beans, salt), Unbleached wheat flour ***Unsalted butter, whole eggs, black sesame seeds, nonfat dry milk***CONTAINS: EGGS, MILK, WHEAT ***Made by Oyatsupan Bakers Beaverton, OR.
